title: Extension-by-zero criterion for Noetherian cohomology
statement: Let X be a topological space and d>=0 an integer. Assume (1) X is quasi-compact, (2) the quasi-compact opens form a basis of X, (3) the intersection of two quasi-compact opens is quasi-compact, and (4) H^p(X,j_!Z_U)=0 for all p>d and every quasi-compact open j:U \to X, where Z_U is the constant abelian sheaf on U [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and j_! is extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Then H^p(X,F)=0 for all p>d and every abelian sheaf F on X [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology].
